summary: Camp on Wounded Doe Ridge in the Clearwater National Forest, Idaho County, Idaho; abandoned in 1939 and dropped from the fire plan. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Tent camp; the Forest Service list types it as a camp, with no tower described
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1939 and dropped from the fire plan; no source says what, if anything, remains
facts.agency: Clearwater National Forest, USDA Forest Service

visit.trail_note: The Idaho Fire Lookouts page tags the site as a hike-in; no other access source found

events.note: Hartig: Ranger Ralph Hand set up a tent camp with Jess Mosher holding the lookout. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page gives 1922 for Mosher.
Camp dated 1933 by the Forest Service list and firelookout.com. This conflicts with Hartig's 1923 date.
Ranger Hans Roeffler set up a tent camp with Keith McGee as lookout. Radio failed and mirror flashes were used. Hartig says the point was never manned again.
Listed as abandoned in 1939. Hartig says it was eventually dropped from the fire plan.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service list and firelookout.com date the camp to 1933. Hartig says Ranger Ralph Hand first manned the point in 1923. The story gives both dates and names the sources.
The Idaho Fire Lookouts page gives 1922 for Jess Mosher. Hartig gives 1923. The story follows Hartig and notes the difference.

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree across sources (1922 or 1923 for the first manning, 1933 for the camp date). The Forest Service list has a separate Doe Point row (Sec 26 T34N R11E, camp, 1939, abandoned after 1941). It may be a different site, so it is not merged here. Hartig places Wounded Doe Ridge in Sec 12 T34N R11E. The record coordinates (46.34221, -114.97592) are not checked against any source. No access status and no present-day description were found. No new photos were captured. The firelookout.com page has a larger image but no usable URL was recorded.
